fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
No kickoff call until all four accounts are shared

Fernbrook Social asks each new client to share access on all four social accounts, never a password. Harbor Coffee Roasters has shared three. With TikTok missing, the kickoff call stays unbooked, and Dana Whitlock, Harbor's marketing manager, gets a reminder after two days.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
A 24-shot list built from one questionnaire

Ollie Park shoots half-day brand sessions. For Larkspur Ceramics, the questionnaire asked which shots the owner wanted in each spot: 10 in the studio, eight on the shop floor and six on the street outside. The answers became a 24-shot list grouped by location, with the client's notes beside each shot.
